xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4422: Add GPT-6.1 Sol (gpt-6.1-sol): catalog, cost, Codex floor 0.159.0; release to npm

plan.title: Add GPT-6.1 Sol (gpt-6.1-sol): catalog, cost, Codex floor 0.159.0; release to npm
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: One new model id propagated across every model surface (capabilities, providers, fallback, cost, Codex floor, Codex and Claude Code context pins, server API map, Settings catalog, two pickers, display name, docs, changelog). This is the same file set as #4234 (GPT-6 Sol/Luna) and #4327 (Sonnet 5.5); each item is a one-to-few-line edit and splitting into sibling issues would ship a model that is selectable but unpriced or unpinned.

narratives.Problem: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Sol (gpt-6.1-sol) on 2026-09-29. Overdeck does not know the id: it cannot be picked, is not priced, gets no 272K context pin on Codex (codex.ts only matches 'gpt-6-' and 'gpt-5.6-' prefixes), and Codex below 0.159.0 under ChatGPT sign-in fails with HTTP 400 instead of a clear refusal.
narratives.Proposal: Add gpt-6.1-sol as an opt-in OpenAI model everywhere gpt-6-sol appears, with the same frontier class, 272K pin and effort levels, its own $2/$0.10/$10 pricing, a Codex floor of 0.159.0, and CLIProxy (claude-code) route support verified by probe. Update harnesses.mdx, MODEL-CONTEXT-AUDIT.md and the Unreleased changelog block. No defaults change. The npm release runs post-merge from main.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Releasing to npm; after merge the operator or flywheel runs `pan release stable --version 0.64.0` from main.
- Changing any default, PROVIDERS.openai.tierModels, provider preset (#4400), role model or workhorse slot.
- Changing, deprecating or remapping any gpt-6-sol row, even though CLIProxy no longer serves gpt-6-sol.
- Bumping CLIPROXY_RELEASE_VERSION.
- Rebuilding sync-sources/hooks/record-cost-event.js (it has no GPT-6 rows today; pre-existing gap).
- Editing evals/ or tests/unit/evals/.
- Adding a [372k] or 872K variant for gpt-6.1-sol.
- Surfacing the Codex 'ultra' effort level.
- Editing scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt.

autoDecisions.rationale: #4364 (Sol reclassification) is still OPEN, so the issue's 'unless #4364 reclassified Sol' branch does not apply; the issue asks to keep the two consistent.

autoDecisions.summary: Effort levels low, medium, high, xhigh, max; Overdeck default stays high.
autoDecisions.rationale: Codex 0.159.0 catalog lists the same efforts as gpt-6-sol plus 'ultra', which Overdeck already omits for GPT-6 Sol; the effort-high-default rule forbids xhigh/max defaults.

autoDecisions.summary: Apply the 272K billing-tier pin and label '(272K context)'.
autoDecisions.rationale: Codex 0.159.0 `codex debug models` reports context_window 272000 / max 872000 for gpt-6.1-sol, identical to gpt-6-sol; the issue asks the label to match how Overdeck caps GPT-6 Sol.

autoDecisions.summary: CLIProxy implementation checkpoint resolved: the claude-code route is supported.
autoDecisions.rationale: Planning probe against the pinned CLIProxyAPI 7.3.16: /v1/models lists gpt-6.1-sol and /v1/messages returned a real completion. So gpt-6.1-sol joins GPT_56_MODELS and the cliproxy.ts note records the verification.

autoDecisions.summary: Fix codex.ts:295 so 'gpt-6.1-sol' gets model_context_window = 272000 by adding a startsWith('gpt-6.') branch.
autoDecisions.rationale: 'gpt-6.1-sol' does not start with 'gpt-6-'; without the fix Codex sessions would run unpinned past the 272K billing tier. Bare 'gpt-6' is avoided so unrelated future ids are not caught.

autoDecisions.summary: Order gpt-6.1-sol right after gpt-6-astra and before gpt-6-sol in ordered pickers; append after gpt-6-luna in plain membership lists.
autoDecisions.rationale: Newest-first within the Sol tier in UI; appending in unordered arrays mirrors #4234 and keeps diffs minimal.

autoDecisions.summary: Changelog goes in the top Unreleased block, creating a v0.64.0 Unreleased block if none exists.
autoDecisions.rationale: v0.63.0 is tagged and package.json is 0.63.0; docs/RELEASING.md defines the Unreleased block format and finalizes it on release day.

autoDecisions.summary: The npm release is a post-merge step, not a work item.
autoDecisions.rationale: Releases run only from main via `pan release stable`; the same split was used for PAN-4327 (Sonnet 5.5).

autoDecisions.summary: Add gpt-6.1-sol to routes/settings.ts MODEL_API_IDS on the existing line 109.
autoDecisions.rationale: The file is at its 1104-line allowlist cap and agents may not raise allowlist rows.
